background_image_description: Abstract backdrop of five wide, gently wavy horizontal bands spanning the full 1280x1600 canvas: top band mustard-gold (#d3b062), second band pale beige (#ead9c9), middle band warm coral-orange (#f19373), fourth band soft pink (#f6a3b4), and bottom band light cream-beige (#e9d9cd). Each band curves smoothly with diagonal transitions from left to right.

nodes.asset_description: Centered white paper note with subtle paper texture, soft drop shadow to the right and bottom, and a curled/peeled bottom-right corner revealing a gray underside. A metallic silver paperclip (chrome with inner shadow) is clipped at the top edge slightly left of center, overlapping the note and casting a small shadow on the paper.
